fullPassage: Norms emerge in groups as a result of people conforming to the behavior of others. Thus, the start of a norm occurs when one person acts in a particular manner in a particular situation because she thinks she ought to. Others may then conform to this behavior for a number of reasons. The person who performed the initial action may think that others ought to behave as she behaves in situations of this sort. Thus, she may prescribe the behavior to them by uttering the norm statement in a prescriptive manner. Alternately, she may communicate that conformity is desired in other ways, such as by gesturing. In addition, she may threaten to sanction them for not behaving as she wishes. This will cause some to conform to her wishes and act as she acts. But some others will not need to have the behavior prescribed to them. They will observe the regularity of behavior and decide on their own that they ought to conform. They may do so for either rational or moral reasons.

✅② 위협을 통해 제재하겠다고 함 — she may threaten to sanction them for not behaving as she wishes, 일치
✅③ 규정 없이 스스로 순응 결정 — some others will not need to have the behavior prescribed... decide on their own, 일치
❌④ 이유가 언제나 도덕적인 것에 한정 — 본문 either rational or moral reasons(합리적 또는 도덕적) ←정답
det.tip: 함정: either A or B(둘 중 하나) → '언제나 B에만 한정'은 왜곡

ch: 규범의 시작은 한 사람이 특정 상황에서 특정한 방식으로 행동할 때 일어난다.
최초 행동자는 자기 뜻대로 행동하지 않는 이들을 제재하겠다고 위협할 수 있다.
어떤 이들은 규범을 규정받지 않고도 스스로 순응하기로 결정한다.
규범에 순응하는 사람들의 이유는 언제나 도덕적인 것에 한정된다.

questions.passage: Norms emerge in groups as a result of people conforming to the behavior of others. Thus, the start of a norm occurs when one person acts in a particular manner in a particular situation because she thinks she ought to. Others may then conform to this behavior for a number of reasons. The person ①<u>who performing the initial action</u> may think that others ought to behave as she behaves in situations of this sort. Thus, ②<u>she may prescribe the behavior</u> to them by uttering the norm statement in a prescriptive manner. Alternately, she may communicate that conformity is desired in other ways, such as by gesturing. In addition, she may ③<u>threaten to sanction them</u> for not behaving as she wishes. This will cause some to conform to her wishes and act as she acts. But some others will not need to have the behavior prescribed to them. They will observe the regularity of behavior and ④<u>decide on their own</u> that they ought to conform. They may do so for either rational or moral reasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: performing → performed: 주격 관계대명사 who가 이끄는 절에는 정동사가 필요하므로 과거형 performed가 올바르다.
det.analysis:
❌① who performing the initial action — 원문 performed. 주격 관계대명사 who절에는 정동사 필요 → performed 필수 ←정답
✅② she may prescribe the behavior — 조동사 may + 동사원형 prescribe 정상
✅③ threaten to sanction them — threaten + to부정사 정상
✅④ decide on their own — 조동사 will + 동사원형 decide 정상
det.tip: 관계대명사절 = 주어+정동사. who performed(정동사) ↔ who performing(분사, 불가)

questions.passage: Thus, she may prescribe the behavior to them by uttering the norm statement in a __________ (prescribe) manner. Alternately, she may communicate that conformity is desired in other ways, such as by gesturing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: prescribe → prescriptive: 관사 a와 명사 manner 사이에서 명사를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 형용사형 prescriptive가 와야 한다.
det.analysis: in a __________ (prescribe) manner — 관사 a + ___ + 명사 manner. 명사를 수식하는 형용사 자리 → 형용사형 prescriptive. prescribe(동사) → prescriptive(형용사, 규정적인).
det.tip: 관사 + ___ + 명사 → 형용사 자리. prescribe → prescriptive(규정적인)

det.analysis:
